paite: Kuapeuh kituamseh in ama deihlam azong a, huan pilna hoih tengteng tung ah athangpai hi.
english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

paite: Theihsiamna ah mihai in kipahna anei kei, himahleh alungtang a kitaklat theihna ding ahi.
english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

paite: Migilou ahong chiang in, muhsitna leng ahong pai a, zahtaklouhna toh zumna ahong pai hi.
english: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

paite: Mihing kam thute tui thukte bang ahi; pilna tuikhuk luangte bang ahi.
english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

paite: Migilou guptuam ahoih kei, vaihawmna a midiktat nawlkhin leng.
english: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

paite: Mihai mukte kiselna ah alut a, huan akam in zepna asam hi.
english: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

paite: Mihai kam asiatna ahi, huan amukte akha a ding a thang ahi uh.
english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

paite: Huauhatmi thute tanghou limtak bang ahi a, gil sungnungpen pen ah atumsuk uhi.
english: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

paite: Anasepna ze-ol leng hihsemi a ding in unau ahi.
english: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

paite: TOUPA min insang muanhuai ahi; midiktat huai ah atailut a, abit hi.
english: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

paite: Mihau hauhsakna a khopi muan ahi, ama ngaihdan a kulhbaang sangtak bang.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

paite: Siatna ma ah mihing lungtang aki-uangsak a, zahna ma ah kiniamkhiakna apai hi.
english: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

paite: Kuapeuh azak ma a dawnna pia, amah a ding in haina leh zumna ahi.
english: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

paite: Mihing lungsim in athuakgimna apozou a; himahleh lungsim puakkham kua in thuakzou ding?
english: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

paite: Mipilvang lungtang in theihna amu a; huan mipil bil in theihna azong hi.
english: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

paite: Mihing thilpiak in amah a ding in omna abawl a, huan mithupite ma ah amah api hi.
english: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

paite: Kuapeuh agen masa dik in akilang phot hi; invengte hong pai a amah ahong zonkhiak masiah.
english: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

paite: Aisan in kiselna atawpsak a, huan mihatte kikal ah akhen hi.
english: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

paite: Unau hihkhasiat khopi muan sang in lak ahaksa zaw; huan huchibang kiselna kulhpi sikchiangte ahi.
english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

paite: Mihing gilpi akam a gah in adim ding; amukte punna a hihlungkim in a-om ding hi.
english: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

paite: Sihna leh hinna lei thilhihtheihna ah a-om; huan huai itte'n huai gah ane ding uh.
english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

paite: Kuapeuh zi mu in thil hoih mu ahi a, TOUPA a kipan deihsakna atang hi.
english: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.

paite: Genthei in kamdam in akhem sek a; himahleh hausa in khauhtak in adawng hi.
english: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

paite: Kuapeuh lawm tampite bawl in amah siatna ahih a; himahleh unau sang a ginomzaw lawm khat a-om hi.
english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
